name: ghbar
title: GHBar
description: Pull requests and issues other people opened on your repositories, in the menu bar. The contributions people send you, without the rest of the notification inbox.
author: denizyoldas

commands.name: ghbar
commands.title: GHBar
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Shows pull requests and issues waiting on you in the menu bar.

commands.name: configure-scope
commands.title: Configure Scope
commands.subtitle: GHBar
commands.description: Pick which organizations and repositories GHBar watches, from your live GitHub lists.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with GitHub through Raycast instead.

preferences.name: includePrivateRepos
preferences.title: Scope
preferences.label: Include private repositories
preferences.description: Requests the broader 'repo' scope so private repositories are searched too. Only applies to the Raycast sign-in, not to a personal access token.

preferences.name: showChangesRequested
preferences.title: Sections
preferences.label: Changes Requested
preferences.description: Your own pull requests where a reviewer asked for changes.

preferences.name: showReviewRequested
preferences.label: Review Requested
preferences.description: Pull requests waiting on your review.

preferences.name: showPullRequests
preferences.label: Pull Requests
preferences.description: Pull requests other people opened on your repositories.

preferences.name: showIssues
preferences.label: Issues
preferences.description: Issues other people opened on your repositories.

preferences.name: showMyPullRequests
preferences.label: My Pull Requests
preferences.description: Your own open pull requests, anywhere.

preferences.name: showDrafts
preferences.title: Filters
preferences.label: Show draft pull requests
preferences.description: Draft pull requests are still work in progress; hide them if they are noise.

preferences.name: showBots
preferences.label: Show bots (Dependabot, Renovate, …)
preferences.description: Dependabot, Renovate and friends. Off by default — automated pull requests are not contributions people sent you.

preferences.name: accounts
preferences.title: Watched Accounts
preferences.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins whose repositories to watch. '@me' is you. Ignored while organizations are set.

preferences.name: organizations
preferences.title: Organizations
preferences.description: Comma-separated organization logins. When set, GHBar shows work ASSIGNED to you inside those organizations and the watched accounts are ignored — GitHub search ANDs 'user:' with 'org:' and would always return nothing.

preferences.name: repositoryFilterMode
preferences.title: Repository Filter
preferences.description: How the repository list below is applied.

preferences.name: repositoryList
preferences.title: Repository List
preferences.description: Comma-separated repositories. A bare name like 'webapp' is completed with the first organization, or the first watched account. Ignored while the filter above is off.

preferences.name: repoGroupThreshold
preferences.title: Group Noisy Repositories
preferences.description: A repository with more open items than this collapses into a single submenu, at the position of its newest item.

preferences.name: maxRowsPerSection
preferences.title: Rows per Section
preferences.description: How many rows a section shows before the rest move into a 'more…' submenu.

preferences.name: rateLimitVisibility
preferences.title: Rate Limit Row
preferences.description: The remaining GitHub API quota. Always reachable from the Refresh item's tooltip.
